content.title: Vehicle Journey Reveal | Landmark Descent, Driver Proof, Route Closure
content.summary: A wind-farm architect drives one utility coupe from landmark reveal to service arrival. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: A destination-scale view narrows to one identifiable carrier. + The same carrier and route direction persist. + The adult operator is revealed through a motivated access action. + Interior and exterior views preserve identity and vehicle geometry. + The final stop connects route, carrier and human purpose.
quick_start.recommended_input: Descend from an original coastal wind tower to one cobalt electric utility coupe on the access road. Open the driver door once to reveal one clearly adult maintenance architect in an orange field jacket. End behind the same coupe as it stops at the marked service bay with tower, vehicle and driver purpose connected.
